title: 心理学基礎実験実習
subtitle: Practice of Elementary Psychological Experiments
educationalGoal: The aim of this course is to understand the concept of experimental psychology and to acquire deeper knowledge of experimental methods to obtain accurate results through exercises of elementary psychological experiments. Students will also learn statistical analysis and evaluation of experimental data.
advice: In this class, students participate in the entire process of psychological research using experimental methods, namely conducting experiments (especially experiments on sensation and perception, memory, cognition and social behavior), analyzing the experimental data, and writing paper on the results of experiments. Throughout the semester students will participate in several cycles of research (conducting experiments, analysis, writing reports). It is very important to have practical experience in conducting experiments, to understand psychological phenomena and to analyze the data. Therefore, marks will be deducted for absence and tardiness. Students must bring their own PC to every class.
books: Reference books are specified in each topic.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of psychology and experimental methods studied in the “Introduction to Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” courses in the previous semesters is required.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand basic concept of psychological experiments.
Ability to adequately conduct psychological experiments.
Ability to analyze experimental data in adequate methods.
Ability to write paper on psychological experiments following the appropriate format.

achievementLevels.ideal: Understand the concept of experiments in psychology through experiments and exercises. Acquire skills to conduct experiments related to sensory perception, memory, cognition, and social behavior. Acquire knowledge on how to conduct experiments to obtain accurate results and apply this knowledge to their own experiments. Ability to conduct appropriate statistical analysis of experimental data. Ability to write research papers reporting the results of experiments accurately and logically in an appropriate format.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand the concept of experiments in psychology through experiments and exercises. Acquire skills to conduct experiments related to sensory perception, memory, cognition, and social behavior. Acquire knowledge on how to conduct experiments to obtain accurate results. Ability to conduct appropriate statistical analysis of experimental data. Ability to write research papers reporting the results of experiments in an appropriate format.

lessons.assignments: Review the basics of psychology and experimental methods studied in previous semesters.

lessons.content: 1st term (1) Stroop Effect: Experiment, data analysis, writing report
1st term (2) Stroop Effect: Review and comments on the Stroop effect.
1st term (3) Muller-Lyer illusion: Experiment, data analysis, writing report
1st term (4) Muller-Lyer illusion: Review and comments on the Muller-Lyer illusion.

lessons.assignments: Homework on statistical test and t-test
